snippet.title: The real AI shift this week is operational, not flashy
snippet.description: Map one repeated business process this week — for example, meeting notes to summary, request to first draft, or research to internal brief — and test whether AI can remove two handoffs without creating a new approval problem. Keep the human owner clear. ([openai.com](https://openai.com/index/chatgpt-for-your-most-ambitious-work/))Read the full brief: https://clearforge-daily-brief.netlify.app/posts/2026-07-11-alt.html
